defect: Base-landscape coordinates were serialized to three decimals after the distance matrix was computed from unrounded in-memory coordinates. The parser reconstructs distances from the serialized points, so the stored generator matrix was not exactly the parser-effective matrix.
mathematical_effect_on_future_runs: Without correction, the solver would still use parser-effective distances consistently, but the frozen base JSON and generator audit would claim slightly different distances and their identities would not describe the exact parsed model data.
required_fix: Round coordinates first, compute and serialize distances from those exact serialized coordinates, regenerate all base/fleet/scenario identities, and issue a superseding corrected Stage 0 freeze before any optimizer run.
